verdict.rationale: The evidence shows Xero ships an MCP *server* (xero-mcp-server) so external AI agents can call Xero's tools — the opposite direction from this story, which asks whether a user can plug external MCP servers *into* Xero so Xero can consume their tools. Xero is a SaaS accounting platform, not an agent/host application, so acting as an MCP client that consumes other servers' tools is not a fitting capability for this product type.
